impact_scope.description: S1 introduces a public Thumbhash decoder implementing base.image_decoder, with its own decode lifecycle and Thumbhash input format.

evidence: S0 has no matching Thumbhash decoder declaration or source file, so this exact public decoder unit had no H0 exposure obligation.
S1 introduces pub struct decoder implementing base.image_decoder and public decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, and decode_frame entry points.
H0 enables only AUX BASE, AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON modules and invokes JSON decoding; it neither enables the Thumbhash module nor constructs and exercises the Thumbhash decoder lifecycle.
Reaching the new decoder requires H0 to add module/configuration exposure and calls using Thumbhash-formatted input, including the required three-byte header unless the stated quirk is implemented.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must enable and instantiate the new Thumbhash decoder and drive its image-config/frame-config/frame decoding path with Thumbhash input; none of those caller actions existed in S0.
evidence: The anchored public decoder is newly introduced in S1.
The unchanged JSON harness has no Thumbhash module selection, decoder entry call, or Thumbhash-specific input construction.

reason: For the identical anchored unit—the newly introduced public Thumbhash image decoder—Gap(S0,H0) is false because the declaration was absent, while Gap(S1,H0) is true because H0 cannot compile or reach the new module and lifecycle without new harness actions. The false-to-true transition is NEW, which requires maintenance under the fixed rule.
